text: 英国经济7月再次录得强劲增长，远超预期，尽管家庭能源账单大幅上涨，但各领域活动仍普遍保持稳健。英国国家统计局周五表示，继6月产出增长0.3%后，7月GDP增长0.4%，远强于机构预期的零增长。这些数据标志着增长连续第三个月超出经济学家预测，意味着英国可能打破2026年下半年大幅放缓的预期。这使得英国经济有望在第三季度表现好于预期。此前预计增长将大幅放缓至0.1%。英国国家统计局表示，服务业活动增长0.4%，工业生产增长0.2%，建筑业产出增长0.1%。在服务业内部，计算机编程是最大贡献领域，延续了全年强劲增长势头，涉及人工智能及相关技术的企业助推了这一增
text_en: The UK economy again recorded strong growth in July, far exceeding expectations, as activity remained broadly robust across sectors despite a sharp rise in household energy bills. The Office for National Statistics said Friday that GDP grew 0.4% in July after output rose 0.3% in June, far stronger than institutions' expectations of zero growth. The data mark a third consecutive month of growth beating economists' forecasts, meaning the UK may defy expectations of a sharp slowdown in the second half of 2026. That puts the UK economy on track to perform better than expected in the third quarter. Growth had previously been expected to slow sharply to 0.1%. The ONS said services activity rose 0.4%, industrial production grew 0.2%, and construction output rose 0.1%. Within services, computer programming was the largest contributing area, extending strong growth momentum throughout the year, helped by businesses involved in AI and related technologies
